business.what: Kaynes Technology is a vertically integrated electronics manufacturing services provider that designs and manufactures electronic systems and components for various industrial and commercial customers.

segments.name: Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS)
segments.note: The company operates predominantly in one business segment of Electronics Manufacturing Services.

metrics.label: Revenue growth
metrics.reading: Revenue compounded 54% a year over 5 years, 48% over 3 (slowing); last 12 months 35%.

metrics.label: Profit growth
metrics.reading: Profit compounded 104% a year over 5 years, 51% over 3; last 12 months 9%.

metrics.label: Cash conversion
metrics.reading: Over 5 years, operating cash flow was -63% of net profit (weak).

metrics.label: Debt
metrics.reading: Borrowings ₹913 cr, 0.19× equity; up from ₹189 cr in FY22.

bull.point: Management successfully delivered on their FY26 EBITDA margin target of at least 15.6%.
Management demonstrated confidence by raising their FY27 revenue guidance for the PCB and OSAT business.
Operating margins have consistently expanded from 13% in FY22 to 16% by FY26.

bear.point: The company significantly missed its FY26 revenue target of ₹4,500 crores.
Working capital efficiency deteriorated significantly, missing the 85-day target by a wide margin.
Operating cash flow has been weak, averaging negative 63% of net profit over the last five years.
